description: Sandbox build executor for Sealos deploys: build a container image from source with an in-cluster Kaniko Job and push it to GHCR, for environments without a Docker daemon (Brain managed Devbox sandboxes). Use only when a managed deploy (SEALAI_DEPLOY_MODE=managed) needs an image built from project source; local interactive deploys build with docker buildx instead (see the use-sealos skill).
